summary: The goto loop becomes an equivalent do/while with the same three exits and the count<4 back edge; the scratch_c/scratch_d holders become the same addresses taken from the 0x1F8001B0 work area the function already indexes, and the work holder becomes the literal the prototype and sibling callers use; no FAKE remains, no banned construct, and no false text.

findings.explanation: Same exits as the goto version: positions equal; first collision test returning 0 copies *pos2 then exits; second test non-zero exits; the back edge only after count++ when count < 4. Nothing follows the loop.

Same addresses. The function reads that buffer as shorts at +0x10..+0x14 and writes scratch[8..10] to the other, so these really are sub-buffers of one work area; the old body already used scratch + 6 and scratch + 12 the same way. One raw scratchpad base, not a named symbol.
The prototype's last parameter is an s32 (include/bb2.h:954), and sibling callers pass the same literal (9F9C.c:3557, 4510C.c:991).

findings.construct: FAKE label and its header-comment mention removed
findings.explanation: The labelled holders are gone, so removing the label is correct. Zero FAKEs is the simplest form and is the one reported as scoring 0.

hygiene_debt: ScrPad (include/game.h:1381) has no named view of the 0x1F8001B0..0x1F8001EF temporary work area, which overlaps unkA8 under a different layout; fighter_ResolveMovement indexes it through a raw s32* base.
